title: Every capability of the Spacelift reference, with infraweave's plan for it
description: One record per tag of each Spacelift product's reference (Deploy's api/reference/spacelift/spacelift.openapi.yaml, Flows' api/reference/spacelift-flows/flows.openapi.yaml), named with its product; per untagged operation, per resource and data source of terraform-provider-spacelift v1.57.0, and per BillingTierFeature value. spacelift holds report 26's research: the cells are markdown, and the labels [D], [G], [B], [S], [RN], [C] and [I] are report 26's source labels. infraweave holds the capability roadmap's columns: the feature that gates the row, its lowest seeded tier, the phases of docs/implementation/plan.md that build it and its availability state.

phase.description: A phase of docs/implementation/plan.md, or none for a superseded row.

inventory.description: Tags: the report that lists the tag's operations one by one.

owningReport.description: The report that records the behaviour; the first named owns most of it.

plan.description: The lowest SaaS plan that offers the capability, in report 26 section 1.3's vocabulary.

tierFeatures.description: BillingTierFeature values that reports 03 and 04 pair with the row's operations, by name.

rootFields.description: Terraform rows: the count of GraphQL root fields the provider calls.

calls.description: Terraform rows whose code calls root fields through a query another file declares, which api/reference/spacelift/terraform-operations.json does not record: those root fields. specref parity --states computes the row's state over them instead.

meaning.description: BillingTierFeature values: what the value gates.

selfHosted.description: BillingTierFeature values: what self-hosted and FedRAMP offer.

operationsTagged.description: BillingTierFeature values: the operations reports 03 and 04 pair with the value; zero means no operation's name matches it.

feature.description: The features of docs/data/features.json that gate the row or cover the value.

lowestTier.description: The lowest seeded tier of each feature the row names.

phase.description: The owning phase: the one whose exit makes the row implemented.

apiPhase.description: Terraform rows: the phase that serves the core operations the row calls.

providerPhase.description: Terraform rows: the phase that builds the row in infraweave's provider.

also.description: Tags: the phases that deliver some of the tag's operations, with what each delivers.

state.description: The availability state of decision 0021 that the record claims; at the research baseline, 2026-10-28, report 26's computed state.specref parity --states --check fails when it claims more than the passing scenarios show.

delivers.description: BillingTierFeature values: what the phase delivers.

product.description: The Spacelift product whose reference or provider the row comes from, or infraweave for a tag of infraweave's own whose every operation carries x-upstream: none, outside the parity surface; docscheck holds each reference's tags to its own product's tag records.

ops.description: Tags: the operations the reference files under the tag, or for infraweave's own tag the served document does.

number.description: BillingTierFeature values: the value's position in the enum.
